user_constraint_array.name: Gas_MaxOpDay_Colbun
user_constraint_array.description: Gas_MaxOpDay consolidated for fuel-owner group 'Colbun' (8 PLEXOS Day_X rows merged into one daily_sum UC).  PLEXOS evaluates each Day_X as a per-day cumulative budget (Σ_blocks_in_day_X hr·gen·Δt ≤ RHS_X); the per-block RHS profile here broadcasts the per-day cap to every block in its day so gtopt's daily_sum aggregator (see user_constraint_lp.cpp:1027) picks up the right per-day RHS at each day-ending block.  Days mapped: gtopt day d ← PLEXOS Day_{d+1}; PLEXOS Day0 partial-start cap is dropped (LP's first 24h uses the wider Day1 cap).  Soft at $1000/unit since PLEXOS itself takes slack on these (Day1/Day4/Day6 have non-zero pid-3070 Slack in RES20260422.accdb).  File: DBSEN_PRGDIARIO.xml
